archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-kv
archetypes.rationale: Review the Step 5 result-env persistence against bgjob merge-result expectations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the review_and_fix Step 5 envelope changes. Focus on whether every terminal loop path still emits the legacy stdout KVs while writing the same data to the mergeable result-env file. Check newline handling, symlink refusal, and whether optional difficulty rows remain compatible with existing parsers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
